# Third-Party Notices

The files in `Runtime/Textures/Original` are conversions of diffuse textures
supplied by the user from an itch.io download named "Wheat Textures BB". This
package does not grant any additional rights to those files. Confirm the
original itch.io license before redistributing them or a package containing
them.

The ready-to-use transparent files in `Runtime/Textures/Stages` were generated
for this local Unity conversion because the source package did not contain its
required FS22 alpha maps.
